title: Croatian Pilaf with Mascarpone
description: A hearty twist on traditional pilaf, with the richness of mascarpone cheese. Perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the grated carrot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the mascarpone cheese and butter until melted and well combined.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
